content: The verse is unpublished; Dībājī reproduces five ghazals, three rubāʿīs and some Arabic verses from f. 121b in his edition of the K. al-Manāhij, and Khujandī's Tazkira attributes to Ibn Turka nine rubāʿīs and a fragment of which all but four are certainly by other poets (Abū Saʿīd b. Abī l-Khayr, Awḥadī Marāghaʾī, Niẓāmī, ʿIrāqī, Ḥāfiẓ).
